annotations.title: Create a product from photos or a product page

description: Creates a product from one or more photos (base64 JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB each; extra photos from other angles make the images more accurate) or from a product page link (Amazon, Etsy, Shopify or any shop: its photos and text are used), and analyses it: name, category, materials, colours, selling points, the closest category recipe, facts read from the label, and up to 5 missingFacts (each with a question and an example) to ask the person. Free. Returns the product id for answer_facts and plan_image_set, and analysis: when ok is false, tell the person the problem (e.g. a blurry photo) and offer better photos before planning. Example: {"product_url": "https://example.com/products/mug"}

description.description: What the person says about the product (guides the analysis)

extra_images_base64.description: More photos of the same product from other angles

image_base64.description: The main photo, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is fine)

name.description: Product name, if the person gave one

product_url.description: A product page link, instead of photos
